remediation.fix_approach: Removed both console.log() calls from FieldComponent constructor. FieldComponent is instantiated 100-400+ times per screen render at 5-second polling intervals, producing 1,200-4,800 log entries per minute containing all terminal field.content and field.visualContent data including PINs, account numbers, and transaction codes.
remediation.root_cause: Development debug console.log() statements were not removed before production. No environment.production guard existed. Angular CLI production optimization does not remove console.log() without explicit Terser drop_console configuration. The logs fired unconditionally on every field render in production.
changes_made: src/app/mini-components/field/field.component.ts constructor(): removed both console.log() calls for field.content and field.visualContent
remediation.verification_needed: Open browser DevTools in production build. Navigate through several terminal screens. Verify no '>>@constructor>>>' log entries appear in console.
remediation.defense_in_depth: VULN-011 console.error() in webLogin also removed in the same fix round — addresses the same root cause (unconditional debug output) across multiple components.
remediation.testing: Load a screen with 200+ fields in the terminal emulator. Verify zero console.log entries referencing field.content or field.visualContent.
remediation.residual_risk: Low. Remaining console.log() calls in other files are either behind commented-out code blocks or in paths unrelated to terminal PII. Follow-up: add angular.json Terser drop_console:true for systematic build-time guarantee.
